sql.propToolUtility.getAllForCompany: select u.id, u.utility_company, u.company_id, u.archived, u.active, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(utilityStates))) FROM ( SELECT ust.id, ust.utility_id as "utilityId", s.state, ust.company_state_id as "companyStateId", ust.cost_per_kwh as "costPerKwh", ust.escalator, ust.archived FROM props.utility_state ust inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ust.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE ust.utility_id = u.id and ust.archived is not true) utilityStates), '[]') AS "utilityStates" from props.utility u where u.company_id = :companyId and u.archived is not true order by u.utility_company
sql.propToolUtility.getOne: select u.id, u.utility_company, u.company_id, u.active, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(utilityStates))) FROM ( SELECT ust.id, ust.utility_id as "utilityId", s.state, ust.company_state_id as "companyStateId", ust.cost_per_kwh as "costPerKwh", ust.escalator, ust.archived FROM props.utility_state ust inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = ust.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id WHERE ust.utility_id = u.id and ust.archived is not true) utilityStates), '[]') AS "utilityStates" from props.utility u where u.id = :id
sql.propToolUtility.insert: insert into props.utility(utility_company, company_id, created_by_id, active) values (:utilityCompany, :companyId, :createdById, :active)
sql.propToolUtility.update: update props.utility set utility_company = :utilityCompany, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById, active = :active where id = :id
sql.propToolUtility.delete: update props.utility set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.propToolUtility.insertUtilityState: insert into props.utility_state(utility_id, company_state_id, created_by_id, escalator, cost_per_kwh) values (:utilityId, :companyStateId, :createdById, :escalator, :costPerKwh)
sql.propToolUtility.updateUtilityState: update props.utility_state set company_state_id = :companyStateId, cost_per_kwh = :costPerKwh, escalator = :escalator, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :utilityStateId
sql.propToolUtility.getUtilityStatesByCompan: select us.*, u.utility_company from props.utility_state us inner join props.utility u on u.id = us.utility_id where us.company_state_id = :companyStateId and us.archived is not true
